title: Developer Technology Engineer Intern
description:
We are looking for a Developer Technology Engineering Intern to focus on performance analysis for real-time games and graphics related AI inferencing workloads in Asia Pacific Region with a focus on Japan.
For two decades, NVIDIA has pioneered visual computing, the art and science of computer graphics. With our invention of the GPU, the field has expanded to encompass PC games, movie production, product design, medical diagnosis and scientific research. Today, visual computing plays a central role in how people interact with technology. Our team encourages people with strong interests in computer graphics or improving gameplay with edge inference.
What you'll be doing:
Reviewing and studying graphics intensive 3D applications
Testing and analyzing runtime GPU inferencing workloads
Developing GPU performance testing tools and processes
Participate with some of the most dedicated, ground-breaking game developers throughout Asia Pacific (Japan, Korea, Singapore, New Zealand and more).
Interact closely with the other Developer Technology and Content Management teams at NVIDIA to ensure the best possible experience on GeForce GPUs.
Collaborate with NVIDIA tools engineers on our analysis tools.
Play with the latest GPU technology to understand their performance and develop.
What we need to see:
A desire to learn and curiosity.
Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
A strong interest in the field of 3D graphics and GPU technologies.
Experience in testing 3D applications and games. Understanding the testing process
Proficiency in English communication.
Good interpersonal skills.
Ability to learn. Do you rise to new challenges?
Ways to stand out from the crowd:
A deep understanding of GPU performance and architectures.
Experience with tools for analyzing and optimizing GPU performance.
Ability to communicate in Japanese or Korean at a business level.
An interest in computer games, better yet, a passion.
Some of the skills that we use are esoteric - many engineers do not understand how games engines interact with GPUs. We will absolutely consider candidates without such knowledge but you will need to convince us that you have a strong motivation to learn.
With highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package, NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world's most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and versatile people in the world working for us and, due to unprecedented growth, our world-class engineering teams are expanding fast. If you're a creative and autonomous engineer with a sincere passion for technology, we would like to hear from you!
